faqs.question: Can NRIs buy property in Chennai?
faqs.answer: Yes, NRIs can generally purchase most types of residential and commercial property in India, subject to RBI and FEMA guidelines. As rules can depend on individual circumstances, we recommend confirming specifics with a qualified legal or tax professional alongside our support.

faqs.question: Can Aventrix help an NRI sell property?
faqs.answer: Yes. We help present your property to genuine buyers and coordinate the process on your behalf, from a distance.

faqs.question: Can you assist with rental requirements?
faqs.answer: Yes, we assist NRI owners with finding suitable tenants and coordinating the leasing process.

faqs.question: Can you coordinate property-related activities locally?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our Chennai-based team can coordinate visits, documentation and other on-ground requirements where applicable.

faqs.question: How can an NRI start a property enquiry?
faqs.answer: Simply fill in the form above with your requirement and contact details, and our team will get in touch with you.

faqs.question: What information should I provide?
faqs.answer: Your contact details, what you need help with (buying, selling, leasing, management or investment), and any relevant property details you already have.
